prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE horizontal eight-frame 2D anime chibi pet animation strip, Rita Rossweisse running-left.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is maid outfit/hair identity reference only; no weapons. Image 2 is invisible layout guide only: EIGHT equal slots, never render its marks. Image 3 canonical-base is exact face, head size, body proportions, gloves, skirt, stockings and shoe identity. Image 4 running-right is approved scale/cadence evidence ONLY; DO NOT MIRROR IT. Draw this LEFT-facing animation independently.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Exactly EIGHT distinct complete full-body gait phases in ONE horizontal row, all noses, faces, chests, hips and feet genuinely point viewer SCREEN LEFT, moving left in place. Pure flat opaque #00FF00 backdrop edge to edge. Each complete figure centered in its own equal invisible slot, safe margins, no overlap or cropping. Match canonical and running-right head/body size and crisp 2D linework, restrained cel shading. Compact mature poised chibi, not infant, not 3D.
IDENTITY INVARIANTS: Ash-brown short bob with inward tips; side-swept bangs cover anatomical LEFT eye (front-view screen-right); anatomical RIGHT eye is wine-red (front-view screen-left). Small wine-red rose stays on anatomical RIGHT temple (front-view screen-left), black side bows and white frilled maid headband. DO NOT SWAP SIDES. In this LEFT profile, LEFT side is near camera, so covered left eye remains under fringe and far-side RIGHT rose/right eye may be naturally partly or fully occluded. Prefer natural occlusion over showing the wrong eye or inventing a visible opposite eye. Keep covered eye covered; no second eye, no mirrored hair.
COSTUME: white short puff shoulder sleeves, fitted black corset/bodice, white small waist apron, layered white-frilled black short skirt, attached burgundy bow and limited rose details, dark brown-black long gloves, dark thigh-high stockings, canonical black low-heel shoes. Both hands empty.
EIGHT TEMPORAL PHASES left-to-right: 1 anatomical right leg forward-left contact, opposite arm forward; 2 right leg compression and left recovery; 3 left passing forward and right support, arms passing; 4 left lift approaching next contact with right leg pushing behind; 5 left forward-left contact and right arm forward; 6 left compression with right recovery; 7 right passing forward with left support; 8 right lift approaching frame 1 contact and left leg pushing behind. Readable opposing arm swing, alternation of which leg leads, knees and feet genuinely change phase. Moderate controlled stride and small vertical bob; stable apparent scale. Coherent frame 8 to frame 1 seam. Modest skirt, hair and ribbon follow-through.
Composition: ultra-wide horizontal sprite strip, eight evenly separated figures, full headband through shoes visible, stable foot baseline with hop room, no guides. Each pose about same full-body height; do not shrink any frame.
AVOID: mirrored running-right, right-facing faces, swapped bangs or rose, invented visible left eye, repetition of a static pose, extra or missing frames, huge stride, incomplete limbs, detached decorations, weapons, tools, flowers in hands, floor shadows, glow, blur, trails, dust, effects, scenery, text, labels, borders, guide marks, checkerboard or transparency, chroma green inside character.
qa_note: Eight left-facing phases with naturally occluded eyes; last airborne trailing shoe approaches the right canvas edge and gait halves look similar, requiring extraction QA.
